name: Radiance Surfaces Loss Reformulation
definition: A reformulation of the radiance surface loss function to match the structure of the NeRF loss, allowing for direct comparison and optimization using standard gradient descent while handling stochastic background sampling.
summary: Radiance Surfaces Loss Reformulation converts stochastic background loss into a differentiable form structurally matching standard NeRF, enabling surface-based optimization with scene-space background distribution control.
